gaps: the plan has the buyer send POST /v1/bids, but the buyer's web-console session may not call POST /v1/bids (bids#create is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “the app answers without a server error”
it does not read the record back to confirm what was kept or shown

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app answers cleanly — accepted or refused — but never with a server error.
